summary: Autonomous-auto route selection can incorrectly stage a proposal-backed hydrate_task when the proposal's recommended slice has already been hydrated and completed as a roadmap task. Proposal validation alone is not enough; the route preflight must check live roadmap, backlog, spec, and run-ledger truth for the proposed title/source before opening a hydration child.
evidence: After T-029 completion, lifecycle-route correctly stopped INI-AUTO-001 and INI-EVI-002 because their next-candidate surfaces pointed to completed work. The next candidate search then selected .azoth/proposals/run-ledger-atomic-stage-evidence.yaml because it validated and contained a recommended hydrate_task. Staged architect, planner, and reviewer subagents all blocked the child because live repo truth already had the work as completed T-028 under INI-RST-003, with spec and implementation present. The child was closed without scaffolding duplicate planning artifacts.
recommended_action: Add a proposal-backed hydration preflight to autonomous-auto route selection: before queueing or opening hydrate_task from a proposal, resolve proposed title/source/initiative against roadmap, backlog, specs, and hydration history. If an existing task is complete, route to stop or route-repair instead of opening hydration. If an existing task is active/pending, route to ship_task only when normal gates and approval basis allow it.
